title: Dietitian + Client Success Executive
description:
**Dietitian \+ Client Success Executive** 




  





 We are hiring a Dietitian who genuinely enjoys talking to people and closing conversations, not just writing diet plans.
 



  





 At Niwi, our dietitians do not sit in silos. The best ones on our team are the ones who can explain the value of what we do, handle a hesitant lead on a call, and convert interest into enrollment, without sounding like a salesperson.
 



  





 If you have a clinical background but you have always been the person in the room who is good at persuading, explaining, and building trust fast, this role is built for you.
 



  





**What you will do:** 



* Handle inbound leads via WhatsApp and phone calls and convert them into paying clients
* Conduct brief consultations that double as discovery \+ pitch calls
* Manage active clients on our Standard and Select programs
* Create diet plans, follow up on compliance, and run weekly video sessions
* Work closely with our senior dietitians and sales team to handoff and escalate where needed



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* BSc or MSc in Dietetics, Nutrition, or Food Science (mandatory)
* 1 to 3 years of clinical or online nutrition experience
* Someone who has done client\-facing work and is comfortable on calls
* Strong communication in Hindi and English
* Comfortable using WhatsApp Business, Google Sheets, and basic tools
* Bonus: prior experience in a wellness startup or D2C health brand



  





**What this is NOT:** 



* This is not a pure clinical role where you write plans and disappear
* This is not a pure sales role where outcomes do not matter to you

**What you get:** 



* Fixed salary \+ performance incentive tied to client conversions
* Work with one of India's most experienced nutrition teams (led by Ms. Renu Puri, 35\+ years)
* Fully online delivery model, no hospital shifts
* Real ownership over your client outcomes



  





**Location:** 
 Noida Sector 39
 



**Joining:** 
 Immediate preferred

title: Customer Success Specialist (B2B AI SaaS)
description:
**About the role** 




  





 You'll be the person who takes a signed client from "we just bought this" to "this is running and driving results." At JoyzAI, that means standing up their AI chatbot and AI calling agents end\-to\-end — building the knowledge base, configuring the agent's behaviour, wiring up the lead and CRM flows, and then staying with them so the product actually delivers.
 



  





 This is not a ticket\-closing role. It's a build\-and\-own role. You're technical enough to configure agents yourself, and human enough to make clients feel taken care of at every step. You delight customers by solving the real problem, not by marking a query "resolved."
 



  





 What you'll do
 



  





**Onboarding \& agent setup** 



* Own new\-client onboarding from kickoff to go\-live: scope the use case, gather source material, and set clear delivery timelines.
* Build and structure knowledge bases from client content (websites, brochures, PDFs, FAQs) so the AI answers accurately and on\-brand.
* Configure AI chatbot and AI calling agents across the platform — Tasks, Access, Behaviour, and AI Config — including prompt design, conversation flows, guardrails, and tone (including Hinglish where needed).
* Set up CRM contact fields, ticket types, and automated workflows so leads and conversations route correctly.
* Configure voice agent call handling — greetings, one\-question\-per\-turn flows, voicemail/no\-answer/silence fallbacks, and WhatsApp follow\-ups for links and addresses.



  





**Integrations \& data flow** 



* Wire up lead pipelines — e.g. Meta lead forms → Joyz webhook, Google Sheets automations — and validate that phone/contact data lands clean and deduplicated.
* Coordinate WhatsApp Business API setup with clients (WABA, embedded signup, number provisioning) and troubleshoot access or restriction issues.
* Assist with booking, calendar, and payment integrations where the client's flow requires them.



  





**Ongoing success** 



* Run demos, walkthroughs, and handover sessions so clients can self\-serve confidently.
* Monitor live agent performance, catch weak answers or broken flows, and iterate on prompts and KB content.
* Troubleshoot issues technically before escalating — reproduce, diagnose, and fix where you can.
* Track client health, drive adoption, and surface expansion or churn signals to the team.



  





 Roughly 75% of your time is hands\-on build: software configuration, AI agent design, and API integrations into whatever the client already runs. CRM, ERP, Google Sheets, calendars, WhatsApp, and the odd internal tool nobody has documented.
 



  





 The other 25% is sitting with the client, understanding how their business actually works, and figuring out where our software can move a number that matters to them.
 



  





 That split shifts as the product matures. Expect it to land closer to 60/40 within two years, with more of your time spent on the thinking and less on the plumbing.
 



  





 We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 We don't care too much about experience or degree as long as you have what it takes to do the job.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




 ✨
 **Utmost freedom and autonomy** 
 — to make decisions. You are the taskmaster, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨
 **Complete responsibility** 
 . You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨
 **Top\-of\-the\-market pay** 
 – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨
 **5\-day working** 
 – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨
 **Work from office in Noida** 
 – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨
 **High\-growth startup** 
 – opportunity to be see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.

title: Digital Customer Success Specialist, Insights & Renewal Intelligence
description:
**Digital Customer Success Specialist, Insights \& Renewal Intelligence** 




*Customer Success \| Digital Customer Success* 




  





**Employment type** 




 Full\-time
 



**Experience guide** 




 3–6 years
 



**Reporting line** 




 Manager, Digital Customer Success
 



  





**About the Role** 




**AspenTech, an Emerson company, is a global leader in industrial software, helping organizations optimize operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation.** 




 You will own the account\-intelligence and renewal\-risk workstream, converting multi\-source customer data into repeatable health reviews, early\-warning insights, portfolio reporting, and actionable Customer Success narratives. The role combines hands\-on analysis with process ownership, data quality, stakeholder coordination, and automation readiness.
 



  





**About Digital Customer Success** 




 Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one\-to\-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement, and cross\-functional coordination to help customers realize value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* **Account health reviews:** 
 Build standardised reviews that combine renewal timing, product usage, entitlement, support activity, training, certification, version adoption and customer sentiment into clear strengths, risks and recommended actions.
* **Early\-warning and risk analysis:** 
 Maintain risk inputs, logic, thresholds and tiering; validate outputs and distinguish genuine customer risk from data gaps.
* **Portfolio and segmentation:** 
 Maintain priority account cohorts using approved segmentation rules, renewal timing, risk triggers and stakeholder inputs.
* **Renewal intelligence:** 
 Track renewal cohorts, surface concerns early and prepare account\-level inputs for regional renewal reviews.
* **Risk and leadership reporting:** 
 Produce concise account and portfolio reporting with evidence, data\-quality caveats and recommended follow\-up.
* **CRM health narratives:** 
 Draft and maintain clear health, risk and next\-step entries aligned to the review cadence.
* **Data and source management:** 
 Extract, reconcile and quality\-check information from CRM, BI, usage, support, training, version and survey sources.
* **Cross\-functional collaboration:** 
 Work with account teams, Customer Success Operations and technical data owners to validate context and recommendations.
* **Documentation and controls:** 
 Maintain source links, definitions, standard operating procedures, quality checks, templates and cadence calendars.
* **Automation and enablement:** 
 Help translate review and risk\-reporting processes into scalable workflows while preserving quality and traceability.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **Experience:** 
 3–6 years in Customer Success operations, customer\-health or renewal analytics, business analytics, data analytics or comparable work.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Analytics, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* **Data capability:** 
 Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated experience handling and reconciling multiple data sources.
* **Reporting tools:** 
 Hands\-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI and experience working with CRM data.
* **Business judgement:** 
 Working understanding of customer health, adoption, churn or attrition risk, renewals and Customer Success operating models.
* **Communication:** 
 Ability to convert complex evidence into concise, defensible narratives and practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
* **Operating discipline:** 
 High attention to detail, source traceability, documentation quality and recurring delivery commitments.



  





**Preferred / Nice to Have** 



* **Customer Success platforms:** 
 Experience with Gainsight or a comparable platform.
* **Data and automation:** 
 Exposure to Snowflake or other data\-warehouse extracts, Power Query, SQL, scripting or workflow automation.
* **Relevant models:** 
 Experience developing health scores, early\-warning models, renewal dashboards or executive account reviews.
* **Industry context:** 
 Experience in B2B enterprise software or industrial software.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* **Reliable delivery:** 
 Account reviews, risk refreshes, reports and CRM narratives are accurate and completed against an agreed operating calendar.
* **Actionable insight:** 
 Account teams can understand the evidence, validate the context and act on the recommendations.
* **Data integrity:** 
 Material data gaps are visible and tracked rather than being misclassified as customer risk.
* **Scalability:** 
 Processes and controls are documented and progressively standardised or automated without reducing quality.



  





**How This Role Works** 




 This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across multiple regions and requires effective collaboration in a globally distributed environment. The role enables account teams with structured insights or scaled engagement and does not replace commercial account ownership.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Job Description – Customer Success Manager (CSM)**
**Company:** 
 Aliste Technology
   

  

**Department:** 
 Customer Success
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Customer Success Manager
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Noida
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Head of Customer Success / Head of Support
   

  

**About Aliste Technology**
 Aliste Technology is a smart\-metering and energy\-technology company helping property owners and operators manage electricity consumption, metering, billing and collections more efficiently.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **high\-ownership Customer Success Manager** 
 who can manage assigned clients/properties end\-to\-end and ensure that customers receive consistent service, operational issues are resolved quickly, and properties remain healthy and retained.
   

  

**Role Objective**
 The CSM will be the
 **primary owner of assigned client accounts/properties** 
 after onboarding.
   

  

**The Person Will Be Responsible For**
* Maintaining strong client relationships.
* Ensuring smooth onboarding and installation.
* Monitoring property health and meter performance.
* Driving resolution of grievances and escalations.
* Coordinating with Operations, CCE, Sales and Finance.
* Monitoring outstanding payments and supporting collections.
* Reducing property churn/drop.
* Driving Auto\-Pay and Partner App adoption.
* Conducting regular client reviews.
* Identifying risks before they become escalations.
* Maintaining accurate CRM/Zoho and reporting data.


 The CSM is expected to
 **own the problem until closure** 
 , rather than simply forwarding it to another team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client \& Account Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build strong professional relationships with property owners, operators and key stakeholders.
* Understand each property's business requirements and operational challenges.
* Conduct regular client calls and meetings.
* Maintain proper records of all important client discussions.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Property Health Management


 The CSM should continuously monitor the health of assigned properties, including:
   

  

* Number of active meters.
* Offline meters.
* Installation pendency.
* Replacement pendency.
* Grievances and unresolved tickets.
* Over\-consumption complaints.
* Billing\-related issues.
* Low\-voltage and technical complaints.
* User/deduction\-related issues.
* Outstanding payments.
* Client dissatisfaction/escalation.
* Property drop/churn risk.


 The objective should be
 **zero surprise escalations** 
 —the CSM should identify risks before the client raises them.
   

  

* Grievance \& Escalation Management
* Monitor all open grievances on a daily basis.
* Ensure tickets are progressing within defined TAT/SLA.
* Coordinate with Operations and CCE teams for resolution.
* Follow up with technicians where required.
* Ensure "Under Review" cases are actively followed up and not left unattended.
* Personally handle critical client escalations.
* Keep clients updated until final resolution.
* Ensure closure is properly documented in Zoho.
* Installation \& Operational Coordination
* Coordinate with Operations for new installations.
* Track installation pendency and ageing.
* Ensure technicians complete assigned work properly.
* Ensure final checking/closure processes are followed.
* Coordinate re\-visits wherever genuinely required.
* Ensure client communication happens during important operational activities.
* Identify recurring operational issues and escalate them to management.
* Customer Retention


 The CSM will be directly responsible for reducing customer churn.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Identify properties showing dissatisfaction or drop risk.
* Maintain a Property Risk/Health Tracker.
* Understand reasons behind client dissatisfaction.
* Create action plans for high\-risk properties.
* Escalate commercial/operational risks to management early.
* Conduct regular client health reviews.
* Maintain strong engagement with decision\-makers.


 Retention is a core CSM responsibility, with customer health and churn risk being standard measures in modern customer\-success teams.
   

  

* Outstanding \& Revenue Coordination
* Monitor outstanding amounts for assigned properties.
* Follow up with clients for pending payments.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation.
* Identify accounts where outstanding is increasing.
* Escalate chronic payment delays.
* Support Finance in improving collection timelines.
* Ensure billing/payment\-related client concerns are resolved quickly.
* Auto\-Pay \& Product Adoption
* Drive adoption of Auto\-Pay among assigned properties.
* Encourage clients to use Aliste's Partner App and relevant features.
* Educate clients on the benefits of the system.
* Monitor usage/adoption.
* Identify properties with low adoption and create an action plan.
* Client Meetings \& Reviews
* Conduct regular client meetings.
* Prepare property performance updates before meetings.
* Discuss:
+ Meter health
+ Grievances
+ Installations
+ Collections
+ Consumption\-related concerns
+ Pending actions
+ Overall property performance

* Share MOM after meetings.
* Ensure every action item has an owner and deadline.


 The CSM should act as the
 **single owner coordinating these teams** 
 , rather than allowing the client to chase multiple internal teams.
   

  

* Reporting \& Data Management
* Maintain accurate client/property data.
* Update Zoho/CRM on a real\-time basis.
* Maintain daily/weekly CSM reports.
* Track open grievances and ageing.
* Track property health.
* Track outstanding.
* Track client meetings.
* Track retention/drop risks.
* Share weekly performance reports with management.

title: Group Manager, Global Customer Operations & Growth
description:
**Location:** 
 Delhi/NCR
   

  

**Team Size:** 
 \~1,000 (in\-house \+ vendor/partner)
   

  

**Scope:** 
 Global Customer Base — B2C
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a high\-energy, aggressive, results\-driven leader to own global customer operations for Adobe's global customer base across B2C. This role combines support, vendor management, and revenue growth — leading a large, distributed team to deliver excellent service while actively driving retention and sales outcomes. This is a scale\-and\-transform mandate, not a steady\-state operations role.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own global support operations for Adobe's customers, ensuring consistent, high\-quality service across all channels.
* Drive AI\-led automation and self\-service to improve efficiency and reduce customer effort without compromising quality.
* Manage a large network of vendor/partner teams, holding them accountable to SLAs, quality, and cost efficiency.
* Lead a service\+sales motion — identifying and converting upsell, cross\-sell, and retention opportunities across the B2C base.
* Own retention and cancellation outcomes, setting and driving targets to reduce global churn.
* Lead, coach, and scale a large, multi\-layered global team (in\-house \+ vendor/partner) with an outcomes\-first mindset.
* Set and hold the organization accountable to ambitious metrics — cost\-per\-contact, CSAT, retention, conversion.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales to ensure customer and market signals shape roadmap and strategy.


**What You Bring**
* 12\-18 years in customer operations, technical support, or service delivery, including leading large teams (500\+) with vendor/partner management experience.
* A proven track record driving revenue or retention outcomes within a service organization — not purely cost\-center support experience.
* Strong operational and analytical rigor — comfortable owning hard metrics and driving performance against them.
* Experience with AI\-driven automation or self\-service tooling in a support/CX context.
* Global, cross\-cultural team leadership across global B2C customer bases.
* An aggressive, high\-ownership mindset — energized by scale and transformation.

title: Account Manager
description:
Born in 1995, Airtel aims to offer global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our presence is positioned to serve nearly 96% of the nation's population with infrastructure to sustain cutting\-edge technologies such as 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for consumers, while also preserving the ecological balance.
   

  

 We Create Impact, Take Early Ownership, And Experiment With Different Career Paths As Part Of Our Cultural Fabric. Here’s What You Will Get To Experience As An Airtel Employee
   

  

 Limitless Impact: You get to make a difference to internal and external customers by taking small and big ideas to success and therefore leaving footprints at the scale of billions. And beyond.
   

  

 Limitless Ownership: You get to go above and beyond to take responsibility, challenge the norms and take risks to create big things in more ways than one
   

  

 Limitless Careers: You have the freedom to imagine, and an open canvas available to you to experiment and implement new ideas to gain depth and breadth of experiences.
   

  

 So come join us, and \#BeLimitless.
   

  

**Position Description**
 The purpose of this role is :
   

  

* To ensure business acquisition/growth in his territory by delivering Data (Internet Bandwidth, MPLS, Cloud etc.), Voice (Postpaid), Broadband and Fixed Line Business
* Front\-end the relationship with customer from Airtel side and become the single point of contact for customer for all three lines of business.
* Ensure Customer Market Share (CMS) and Revenue Market Share (RMS) growth in both existing and new accounts.


**Organizational Relationship**
 Reporting To: Team Leader / Zonal Sales Manager
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities**
 Account Management
   

  

* Build and maintain strong, long\-lasting client relationships.
* Deliver Data, Voice and Fixed Line business/revenue as per assigned targets.
* New account break\-in (hunting) for Data, Voice, and Fixed Line.
* Cross\-sell multi\-product lines in existing customers
* Build \& maintain healthy funnels for all three Lines of Business with earmarked levels of maturity
* Track and monitor competition plan \& collect insights for market intelligence
* Negotiate and close orders/contracts to maximize revenue.
* Ensure timely and successful delivery of our solutions as per client needs.
* Enabling resolution of any customer issue directly/indirectly through internal support teams


**Knowledge, Certifications And Experience**
 Education Qualification: Graduate degree preferably B. Tech/B. E
   

  

 Total Experience: 2\+ years of relevant work experience (B2B field sales)
   

  

**Key Interactions**
 Internal: Distribution, network, service, HR etc.
   

  

 External: Customer
   

  

**Technical Competencies**
**Skills and Competencies**
* Understanding of technology
* Customer Service Orientation
* Key Account Planning \& Management
* Executive Presence – ability to handle CXO discussions
* Commercial Acumen
* Creative and Innovative
* Analytical Skill


**Leadership And Behavioural Competencies**
* Customer Obsession
* Collaboration \& Influence
* Ownership Mindset
* Learning Agility
* Navigating Change
* Execution Excellence
